title: Move dial marker inside note labels
prompt:
In lib/widgets/tuner/central_dial.dart, move the selected-note handle inward so it no longer overlaps the dial labels. In _EdgeHandle.build, replace the exact line:
      offset: Offset(0, -(size / 2 - handleSize / 2)),
with:
      offset: Offset(0, -(size / 2 - handleSize / 2 - 32)),
This keeps the handle aligned with the selected note while separating it from the label. Edit only the listed file; change nothing else; no refactors. When done print DONE.
verify: ! git diff --quiet HEAD -- lib/widgets/tuner/central_dial.dart && dart analyze lib/widgets/tuner/central_dial.dart && flutter test test/widgets/tuner/central_dial_geometry_test.dart
